<svg width="300" height="300" viewBox="0 0 300 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <style>
    .line { stroke: black; stroke-width: 3; }
    .x-mark { stroke: red; stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .o-mark { stroke: blue; stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; fill: none; }
  </style>

  <!-- Grid Lines -->
  <line class="line" x1="100" y1="0" x2="100" y2="300"/>
  <line class="line" x1="200" y1="0" x2="200" y2="300"/>
  <line class="line" x1="0" y1="100" x2="300" y2="100"/>
  <line class="line" x1="0" y1="200" x2="300" y2="200"/>

  <!-- Board State: X to move -->
  <!-- The state is set up so that X has two immediate winning lines, and O has one immediate winning line. -->
  <!-- If X plays in the center, X wins. -->
  <!-- If X plays in the top-left (0,0), X wins. -->
  <!-- If X plays in the bottom-right (2,2), X wins. -->
